about: Severity weights for the conflict review workbench's Conflicts tab (_geometry-harness/workbench/ConflictRanking.cs), ranking key 5. A row's weight is the highest weight among the base types of the placed references it names (its Necessary and Alternative records), looked up first under the row's Kind, then under '*'. Base types are the type names the evaluation bundle's names enrichment records for each base (enrichment/names/names.json, bases[].type). A reference whose base the enrichment did not read gets 'unread', and the UI says so. Higher is more severe. Severity is a judgement, so it lives here as data, not in code; it follows the world-edit-compatibility taste rule that things a player uses or a quest needs outrank decorations. The bundle does not say which references a quest uses, so quest membership is not a key yet.
status: PROPOSED 2026-11-14 by the stage-3 implementer; not yet accepted by Piranha. The values below are a first ordering, not measured.
